audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was given to Mel while whys[4] and spikes[1] both say Grandmaster at Arms is the steroid that lets you run her down and that she has no dash to escape.
audit.why: It is the only row that disagrees with the packet chart, and it inverts the page's own biggest Jax spike on a 58.1% matchup.
audit.corrected: Row 4 = Jax with the rating moved to match, proposed as a pair across both layers. Rows 0-3, 5 and 6 already agreed with the packet.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four places tell you Counter Strike dodges Solar Snare: whys[2], spikes[0], early and wants.you[0]. Separately, mid and wants.foe[1] describe Rebuttal as reflecting your committed autos and on-hit back at you.
audit.why: Counter Strike dodges incoming ATTACKS. Solar Snare is a spell — a radiant orb that roots at its centre — and it lands through E at full value; the only answer is to walk out of the zone. And Rebuttal reflects PROJECTILES; Jax is melee, so nothing of his gets reflected. What actually happens is the other clause of Riot's text: it prevents her from taking damage. Every auto you swing into Rebuttal is wasted, not returned. The mirror audit (mel__jax) states the same interaction from her side, so the two pages now agree.
audit.corrected: whys[2], spikes[0], early, wants.you[0], mid and report[5] rewritten: E eats her autos, Solar Snare is sidestepped on foot, and Rebuttal is damage immunity to be waited out.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page names Solar Snare as the tracked cooldown everywhere and never gives a number for anything.
audit.why: The cooldown that actually decides this lane is Rebuttal at 38s at rank 1 — by far the longest thing in her kit and her only defensive tool. Solar Snare is 11s from 1000 range and Radiant Volley 10s, so neither can be waited out; Rebuttal can. Tracking the 11s spell instead of the 38s immunity is tracking the wrong ability.
audit.corrected: Rebuttal's 38s, Solar Snare's 11s/1000, Radiant Volley's 10s and Counter Strike's 17s written into breakdown.cooldowns, and the 38s repeated in mid where the instruction lives.

edits.before: Level 1 is the one window she owns — with only your Q up and no Counter Strike, her Solar Snare and ranged autos chip you for free, so last-hit at max range and don't walk into poke you can't heal back. The lane flips the moment you have the combo: at 2 take W for a Leap-Strike-into-Empowered-hit burst, and at 3 your full kit is online. She has no dash and no escape — once you Leap Strike onto her, recast Counter Strike to dodge her follow-up auto or Solar Snare and stun her, and your sustain eats her poke. Don't throw Q at her on cooldown from range; hold it as your engage.
edits.after: Level 1 is the one window she owns — with only your Q up and no Counter Strike, her Solar Snare and ranged autos chip you for free, so last-hit at max range. The lane flips once you have the combo: at 2 take W for a Leap-Strike-into-Empowered-hit burst, and at 3 your full kit is online. She has no dash and no escape — Leap Strike onto her, then recast Counter Strike to eat the autos she answers with and stun her. E dodges attacks only, so Solar Snare lands through it: step out of that orb on foot. Don't throw Q from range; hold it as your engage.

edits.before: This is your takeover. Leap Strike closes the gap her Solar Snare poke is built to prevent, and Counter Strike's dodge shrugs off the autos and chip she'd use to peel you off while you grind her down. The trick is her Rebuttal — it reflects your committed autos and on-hit, so don't keep swinging into it; bait it or wait it out, then at 6 pop Grandmaster at Arms for the Armor/MR steroid and run her down on its cooldown. With no mobility she cannot get away from your E-stun.
edits.after: This is your takeover. Leap Strike closes the gap her Solar Snare poke is built to prevent, and Counter Strike's dodge shrugs off the autos she'd use to peel you off while you grind her down. The trick is Rebuttal — for its duration she takes no damage at all, so every swing into it is wasted; wait it out, and it is 38s at rank 1. Then at 6 pop Grandmaster at Arms for the Armor/MR steroid and run her down. With no mobility she cannot get away from your E-stun.
